name: YMCA Camp Mountain Laurel Day Camp
operator_name: Hamden/North Haven YMCA (Central Connecticut Coast YMCA)
activities: Specialty weeks: pottery, fort building, engineering, photography, music, theater, dance, cooking, sports, wilderness survival
Swim camps and Aquatic Leader program
description_short: The Hamden/North Haven YMCA's summer day camp on twenty wooded acres at 2705 Downes Road in Hamden, for ages 3 through entering 9th grade, plus a CIT program for ages 14-15. Campers swim in an outdoor pool and do archery, STEAM, hiking, sports, ropes and climbing, and arts and crafts, with weekly themes and specialty camps. Camp runs 9:00 to 4:00.
refund_policy_summary: A $50 deposit per camper per week is due at registration and cannot be refunded or transferred.
special_needs_notes: The Y works with children of all abilities. Families of a child who needs social, behavioral or medical accommodations are asked to contact the Camp Director.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp has an outdoor swimming pool. Weekly activities include swim lessons and recreational swim; beginner and intermediate swim camps are offered, and the intermediate camp requires a skills assessment.

sessions.name: Go For the Gold (Jun 22 to Jun 26)
